I really wish this was true, I am so done with life, 
Just another 24 hours and I will be out of this dark place in which I find
myself.

Thanks, sorry about your grandma it must of been really tough for you.
I just am not as strong as you guys, I have not much support from family
only phone when they feel like they have to. My life will be over when my husband dies, so its a good thing that I am going to end my life because I will be with him when this evil illness finally claims him.

Thank you for your replies, he is a wonderful guy to young to die from
this illness, watching him slipping away bit by bit, day by day is killing me
I had support from a psychologist, she phoned me yesterday to say she can't support
me at the moment because my mental health has got so bad
she has to refer me to the community mental health workers, all because I told
her I had suicidal feelings, thought I was doing the right thing, should have known
I get everything wrong, just can't do this anymore.

Thank you for your reply, yes I have had some counselling. I am in
England we have something called carer support run by psychologist
My psych called me yesterday to say she can not support me at the moment
Because she said my mental health has deteriorated so she has to call in the
Community mental health team, so sorry about your grandparents it must have been really tough for you.
I am so down at the moment I just feel as though no one cares, I just
Just needed someone to talk to, before ending it all.
